name: fog-edge
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent atmospheric fog overlay texture for a mature painterly historical exploration game. A tall vertical strip, aspect ratio 1:2, 768x1536. Subject: extremely soft, delicate, low-contrast ivory-white ground mist. This is an alpha compositing asset: the LEFT edge and leftmost quarter must be completely transparent, with absolutely no backdrop. Wisps of vapor gradually gather from left to right in an irregular natural vertical cloud bank; the middle half has fine translucent atmospheric layers, no recognizable circles, no repeated scallops, no hard silhouettes. The RIGHT edge and rightmost fifth become densely opaque pale ivory fog and blend smoothly into a solid light fog layer. Soft feathered alpha, beautiful organic noise, airy and quiet, subtle hand-painted texture, serious atmosphere. Keep top and bottom consistent so the texture can be stretched vertically without revealing a rectangular border. Actual alpha transparency throughout the left and transition area, not a drawn checkerboard or black background. NO scenery, buildings, silhouettes, animals, sky, horizons, text, icons, frames, shadows, sharp edges or storm clouds. Color nearly white with a tiny warm grey cast; density is expressed primarily through alpha. The output must be an RGBA PNG overlay on transparent background.
